urls.rationale: Part III - Code of Ethics for Public Officers and Employees (ss. 112.311-112.3261) houses the executive-branch lobbying-disclosure regime (F.S. 112.3215 and related sections) administered by the Commission on Ethics.

notes: Chapter 112 partitioned into 8 parts; only Part III (Code of Ethics) contains lobbying-disclosure provisions. Other parts cover employment conditions, retirement, interchange of personnel, removal of officers, law enforcement, actuarial soundness, and firefighters - all out of regime. Pass-3 invoked on part-iii/ to reach section leaves.
